name: samkari-plugins
description: Mohammad Samkari's Claude plugins marketplace: a growing collection of plugins and projects.

plugins.name: persistent-memory
plugins.description: Build and run a Persistent Memory System for long-running projects so Claude stops asking you to re-explain context.

plugins.name: structured-handover
plugins.description: Turn scattered context into a unified, shareable Structured Handover Document (case, project, or trip).

plugins.name: vitals
plugins.description: Offline, config-driven continuity check for any project: required files, fact expiry, state files fresher than work, and drift between derived files and their sources.
